title: A CONSERVATIVE solution to global warming (Part 1)
summary: Potholer54 presents the climate science case and a market-oriented, conservative-friendly approach to addressing global warming, with sources listed. It is part one of a two-part series.
why: HN users recommend it as a model of communicating climate science to conservative and libertarian audiences without alienating them.

quote.text: I've been recommending this video as a quick intro for people who don't feel at home with left wing solutions to climate change
